name: Fathomless Mud of the Swamp
setup: Put 2 Presence on your starting board, in the lowest-numbered Wetland. You start with your 4 Unique Powers and 0 Energy.
playstyle: Likes having {{sacredsite}} where Invaders will Build, but may need to re-create those {{sacredsite}} after oozing outwards with its Innate Power. In smaller games, might be able to cut off the most Inland lands from Explore actions by Destroying Inland Town/City and stopping new ones from being built. Causes a fair bit of Fear, much of which represents unpleasantness, hardship, and disgust.
special_rules: OFFER NO FIRM FOUNDATIONS At your {{sacredsite}}, Build actions add Explorer instead of Town/City.
special_rules_raw:
'''''OFFER NO FIRM FOUNDATIONS'''''

At your {{sacredsite}}, Build actions add {{invader|explorer}} instead of {{invader|town}}/{{invader|city}}.

thresholds.effect: Move 1 Presence from the origin {{sacredsite}} to target land. (This is required.)
